originals.ko: 나는 너희를 신뢰해서 경기하게 할 생각이 없어
originals.why: This line uses bare 'chwarae' in the team or match sense (경기하다), not the LEGO 'yn chwarae' (놀고 있다), so the learner never practises the LEGO.

originals.ko: 내가 너희를 신뢰해서 경기하게 할 수만 있다면
originals.why: This line uses bare 'chwarae' in the match sense (경기하다). 'yn chwarae' (놀고 있다) does not appear, so the LEGO is not practised.
This line uses bare 'chwarae' followed by 'yn yr ardd'. 'yn chwarae' never appears as a unit, and the 경기하다 gloss makes the Korean odd for children playing in a garden.
